title: Quality Improvement Spillovers: Evidence from the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program
eligible_reason: Single policy date: the HRRP penalty phase starts October 2012 (Post = discharges after October 2012). Treatment groups are patient cohorts (A: Medicare 65+ with targeted conditions; B: Medicare 65+ with non-targeted conditions; C: privately insured with targeted conditions) each compared with cohort D (privately insured, non-targeted). Two-group, one-date DiD; no staggered adoption.
design_notes: Discharge-level Nationwide Readmissions Database (HCUP NRD) 2011-2014. Table 2: reg b30readmitted i.Cohort##i.Post $controls if inlist(cohort, X, D), vce(cluster hosp); controls are patient and hospital characteristics, admission month and condition (dxccs1) FE; no hospital or calendar-period FE beyond month-of-year. Variants: LOS, procedures, cost (Table 4), areg with hospital FE, probit and logit robustness, monthly trend figures.
data_access: licensed (HCUP NRD purchasable from AHRQ; DUA forbids redistribution)
data_files_note: Only code, log and readme are shipped; the 16 NRD input .dta files must be purchased.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text in data/text). Package contents read, no code run.
